cards.public_summary: Kyle Monangai has been absent from Bears offseason practices, Mike Moraitis reported.
cards.evidence: In addition to the injuries to Odunze and Swift, the Bears have also been without wide receiver Luther Burden and running back Kyle Monangai at practice during the offseason, although Burden has since returned to action.
cards.commentary: Monangai’s availability is worth monitoring, but the report gives no reason, timetable or indication of a setback. His return to practice would clarify the situation.
cards.author: Mike Moraitis
